title: Editorial triage nominates one or many relevant sections
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a assignment planner, I want cheap fast Jev/Cyclotron decision classifiers to nominate relevant sections, so that more expensive editorial judgment is focused on plausible candidates.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Editorial triage nominates one or many relevant sections
  Scenario: Nominate eligible sections
    Given a candidate Reference and current publication and section guidance
    When the configured fast decision classifiers evaluate section fit
    Then one or several relevant sections may be nominated with attributed prediction evidence
    And nomination means eligibility rather than exclusive editorial ownership
    And no nomination alone creates a human Cyclotron training label
```

Use the existing shared-site Section classifier milestone PPY-0a285b. Jev/Cyclotron is the intended cheap/fast nomination path; actual model/configuration capability must be verified during later implementation. A section-selector suggestion cannot discard other eligible Section-fit nominations. No new engine or price/performance promise.
